Seven percent of people are already using it. The auto sector is at 79 and falling, and this drop will push it lower faster than I modeled. Rick and Patricia are both stressed. Angela is stressed. The consolidation assessment is not a future event — it is happening right now while I am standing on the floor. The HVAC client is signed at $350/month. The math requires either: (a) two more clients at similar rates before I have to make a stay-or-go decision, or (b) the $12,000 stay bonus as a bridge to cover the income gap while I build the client base to self-sufficiency. The RoboRide expansion accelerates the risk that I get laid off before the bonus vests. I need to know my actual qualifying period number now — not in two weeks. I also need to close the restaurant lead I pivoted to in tick 7. The freelance track has one client. One is not a business. Two is a signal. Three is a runway. Every residential service business in Millfield just got handed a cheaper mobility option. That means HVAC contractors might increase service volume — which means they need more visible marketing to capture that demand. My angle just got stronger, not weaker. I need to call the HVAC client contact directly and get a referral. They know other contractors.
